about: The operations of the LetzBill node. The generator (tools/generate-operations.mjs) reads this file and the OpenAPI document named in 'openapi', checks every name here against that document, and writes 'output'. A field, path or parameter this file names that the document lacks fails the generator.

booleanCopy.active: Whether the webhook endpoint is active
booleanCopy.auto_collection: Whether LetzBill collects payment for the subscription automatically
booleanCopy.exclude_from_dunning_campaign: Whether the customer is left out of dunning campaigns
booleanCopy.include_metadata: Whether to include the invoice metadata
booleanCopy.include_snapshot: Whether to include the customer snapshot taken when the invoice was issued
booleanCopy.include_voided: Whether to include voided usage events
booleanCopy.invoice_requires_successful_payment: Whether wallet top-up invoices wait for a successful payment
booleanCopy.overdue: Whether to return only overdue invoices
booleanCopy.receipt_eligible: Whether to return only succeeded payments that have no receipt yet
booleanCopy.reset_consumed_credits: Whether to reset the consumed credits of the wallet
booleanCopy.skip_invoice_custom_sections: Whether invoices for the customer leave out custom sections

inputCurrencyFrom.CreditNoteCreate.credit_amount_cents: the currency of the invoice being credited
inputCurrencyFrom.CreditNoteCreate.refund_amount_cents: the currency of the invoice being credited
inputCurrencyFrom.CreditNoteItemInput.amount_cents: the currency of the invoice being credited
inputCurrencyFrom.OneOffFeeItem.unit_amount_cents: the currency of the customer being invoiced

EventResponse.precise_total_amount_cents: fractional minor units without a currency

WalletTransactionResponse.credit_amount: wallet credits, not a currency amount

descriptions.CreditNoteCreate.description: Text shown on the credit note, up to 2000 characters

descriptions.CustomerCreate.net_payment_term: Number of days the customer has to pay an invoice

descriptions.CustomerCreate.timezone: Time zone of the customer as an IANA name, such as Europe/Luxembourg
descriptions.CustomerCreate.vat_id: EU VAT number of a business customer, such as LU12345678

descriptions.EventCreate.code: Code of the billable metric this usage counts toward
descriptions.EventCreate.external_customer_id: The External ID of the customer the usage belongs to
descriptions.EventCreate.external_subscription_id: The External ID of the subscription the usage belongs to
descriptions.EventCreate.transaction_id: Your unique ID for this usage event, up to 255 characters. LetzBill counts each transaction ID once, so take it from your own data.
descriptions.InvoiceSendRequest.recipient_email: Email address to send the invoice to
descriptions.InvoiceSendRequest.recipient_name: Name of the person the invoice is sent to
descriptions.InvoiceSendRequest.subject: Subject line of the email
descriptions.InvoiceVoidRequest.reason: Why the invoice is voided; LetzBill records it with the invoice
descriptions.OneOffInvoiceCreateRequest.customer_id: ID of the customer to invoice
descriptions.OneOffInvoiceCreateRequest.due_date: Date by which the invoice must be paid
descriptions.OneOffInvoiceCreateRequest.subscription_: ID of a subscription of the customer to link the invoice to
descriptions.PaymentCreate.payable_id: ID of what the payment pays, such as the ID of an invoice
descriptions.PaymentCreate.payment_provider_customer_: ID of the customer at the payment provider, for a 'provider' payment
descriptions.PaymentCreate.payment_provider_id: ID of the payment provider connection to collect through, for a 'provider' payment
descriptions.PaymentCreate.payment_type: Either 'manual', to record a payment you received, or 'provider', to collect it through a payment provider
descriptions.PaymentCreate.provider_payment_method_id: ID of the stored payment method at the payment provider
descriptions.PaymentCreate.reference: Your reference for the payment, such as a bank transfer reference
descriptions.PaymentRefund.reason: Why the payment is refunded, up to 1000 characters
descriptions.SubscriptionCreate.customer_external_id: The External ID of the customer. Set this or Customer ID.
descriptions.SubscriptionCreate.customer_id: ID of the customer. Set this or Customer External ID.
descriptions.SubscriptionCreate.ending_at: When the subscription ends; leave empty for no end date
descriptions.SubscriptionCreate.external_id: Your own unique ID for the subscription, up to 255 characters
descriptions.SubscriptionCreate.plan_code: Code of the plan. Set this or Plan ID.
descriptions.SubscriptionCreate.plan_id: ID of the plan. Set this or Plan Code.
descriptions.SubscriptionCreate.plan_version_id: ID of a specific version of the plan
descriptions.SubscriptionCreate.scheduled_start_at: Date and time to start the subscription later
descriptions.SubscriptionCreate.subscription_at: Date and time the subscription was agreed
descriptions.SubscriptionTerminate.termination_date: Date and time the subscription ends
descriptions.SubscriptionUpdate.plan_id: ID of the plan to move the subscription to
descriptions.WalletCreate.expiration_at: When the credits in the wallet expire
descriptions.WalletCreate.external_customer_id: The External ID of the customer who owns the wallet
descriptions.path.customer.external_id: The External ID you gave the customer

descriptions.query.invoice_status: Only invoices with these statuses, separated by commas: draft, finalized, voided, generating, failed, open, closed, pending, paid, refunded, partially_refunded or pending_approval
